_what: content hashes of every artifact the 4 ASO figures were drawn from
_why: nothing in CI regenerates these figures, so a reader cannot otherwise tell a stale figure from a current one. `--check` compares these hashes against the artifacts on disk.
_regenerate: python3 research/manuscripts/figures/aso_chance_baseline_figure.py && python3 research/manuscripts/figures/aso_gap_length_figure.py && python3 research/manuscripts/figures/aso_junction_space_figure.py && python3 research/manuscripts/figures/aso_multipartner_seam_figure.py && python3 research/manuscripts/figures/svg_to_submission_formats.py && python3 research/manuscripts/figures/aso_figure_provenance.py
_what_this_does_not_check: whether a figure's LEGEND in the manuscript describes the figure. That is a separate failure and it happened: see this module's docstring and test_aso_submission_numbers.py.
